errors.text_span: they maintain a consistent counter-clockwise sequence of teal, tan, light orange, and red-orange across all three charts
errors.evidence: The description states that the counter-clockwise sequence of slices is "teal, tan, light orange, and red-orange". However, in the actual charts, this is the clockwise sequence. The counter-clockwise sequence starting from the teal slice is teal, red-orange, light orange, and tan.
